Requirements:
- Use one 800×800 <canvas> centered on a dark background.
- Allowed external library: dat.gui for parameter controls.
- No other external libraries, frameworks, modules, or assets.
- Everything must be inside a single HTML file.

- Use this exact neon palette:
  - Background: #05070f
  - Background glow: #101a3a
  - Main branch color: #00e5ff
  - Secondary branch accent: #d6ff00
  - Synapse color: #ff2bd6
  - Pulse color: #fff36a
  - UI/accent color: #ffd400

- Use canvas shadowBlur for neon glow effects.
- Do not use images or textures.
- Do not mention any game, movie, brand, or copyrighted visual style in the generated code or comments.

  - Pulses
  - Visuals

  - max branch depth
  - branch split chance
  - branch curvature
  - max branch length
  - synapse distance threshold
  - synapse glow strength
  - pulse speed
  - pulse frequency
  - pulse brightness
  - background color
  - branch color
  - accent branch color
  - synapse color
  - pulse color
- Add buttons:
  - regenerate network
  - clear canvas
  - pause/resume animation

- Each neuron recursively grows branching axon/dendrite lines.

Exact default palette background #05070f, background glow #101a3a, main #00e5ff, accent #d6ff00, synapse #ff2bd6, pulse #fff36a, UI #ffd400, grid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08). No references to brands/games/movies in prose or comments except required library identifiers. Implement full working bounded animated neural growth and electrical pulses. Organize short commented JS sections setup, GUI setup, neuron growth, synapse detection, pulse animation, rendering. Params default neuronCount random integer 3..6, GUI range 3..6; growthSpeed, maxDepth, splitChance, curvature, maxLength, synapseDistance, synapseGlow, pulseSpeed, pulseFrequency, pulseBrightness and colors backgroundColor branchColor accentColor synapseColor pulseColor. Folders precisely Growth, Synapses, Pulses, Visuals; root action buttons named regenerate network, clear canvas, pause/resume animation. Color controls addColor. Grow at fixed small spatial step using elapsed time budget per branch; use bounded dt, max ~260 branches and ~14000 total points, bounded per frame growth. Curving persistent random steering, slight outward bias, occasional side forks shorter/thinner, recursive forks on reaching target until depth limit. Bounds stop near canvas edges. Render paths with midpoint quadratic smoothing and thin strokes shadowBlur neon, occasional accent branches, bright seed bodies. Detect tips including finished tips for connectivity. Ensure sensible default geometry creates connections naturally (threshold ~35-45, branches fairly dense). Pulse route from seed along ancestor branch path to attached tip A, across synapse, back along ancestor path B to target seed: compose ancestor chain arrays via parent attachment indices, no graph pathfinding; precompute polyline lengths per pulse and interpolate by traveled distance. Randomly spawn at frequency rate, max ~40 active pulses, random direction, highlight synapse when pulse crosses; animate tiny bright spark with short trail via shadowBlur and bounded brightness. If no synapses yet, launch pulses along random developed branch paths so scene is always alive, but use real synapse connections preferentially. Stable network continues random pulses indefinitely. Rendering background solid chosen color plus faint radial #101a3a glow, lightweight faint grid/scanlines with canvas only, no image/no noise textures, vignette radial gradient edges. requestAnimationFrame update/render, save/restore alpha/shadow/composite as needed; avoid per-frame heavy path recomputation, cache pulse routes when launching, don't use physics or particle systems.
